block.createnuclear.reactor_rod_input.to: _The Reactor Rod Input_ is a _block_ that can be used to insert _Heating_ or _Cooling_ rods into the Reactor.
Insert _Heating_ (like _Uranium_ or _Thorium_) and _Cooling_ (like _Graphite_) rods in large quantities to power _The Reactor_.
_The Reactor Fluid Input_ is a _block_ that can be used to insert _Water_ or _Liquid Nitrogen_ into the Reactor.
Insert _Water_ or _Liquid Nitrogen_ in large quantities to power _The Reactor_ and avoid _overheating_.
block.createnuclear.reactor_controller.t: The _Reactor Controller_ is the _most important_ block for operating the reactor
it handles all the calculations needed to _generate energy_, it need a _reactor blueprint_ with a pattern to work
block.createnuclear.reactor_output.toolt: _The Reactor Output_ is a _block_ that can be used to extract the mechanical energy generated by the _Reactor_
You can _extract the energy_ produce by the reactor by attaching _shaft_ to the _reactor output_
_Rod_ to be used in the _reactor rod input_ to operate it.
item.createnuclear.uranium_rod.tooltip.s: _Rod_ to be used in the _reactor rod input_ to operate it.
item.createnuclear.thorium_rod.tooltip.s: _Rod_ to be used in the _reactor rod input_ to operate it.
item.createnuclear.reactor_blueprint_ite: It allows you to configure your own pattern.

_Right_ click on the reactor controller to open it.
